apimartStudio.title: APIMart image studio
apimartStudio.intro: Create, edit and refine with GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6. Follow every task from submission to download.
apimartStudio.modelHint: Standard models use token billing. Ext models use per-image billing and have different controls.
apimartStudio.availability26: APIMart has published 2.6 API documentation, while its product announcement still marks availability as pending. Your configured channel may not yet support it.
apimartStudio.ext26Limit: Ext 2.6 currently supports 1K and one output per task.
apimartStudio.sizeHint: Use multiples of 16, edges up to 3840, ratio up to 3:1 and 655,360–8,294,400 pixels. Above 2560×1440 is experimental.
apimartStudio.referenceHint: Up to 16 public image URLs. Upload PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF files up to 20 MB each. Upload links expire after 72 hours; submit before they expire. References enable editing.
apimartStudio.maskHint: Use a transparent PNG under 4 MB, exactly matching the first reference. Fully transparent pixels mark the area to edit. A black-and-white image without alpha is not a mask. Preservation outside the mask is not guaranteed.
apimartStudio.markupHint: Use a separate transparent PNG annotation layer matching the first reference. Do not flatten it into the original. This uploader accepts up to 20 MB; do not combine it with a mask.
apimartStudio.confirmOverlayLabel: I confirm this PNG has transparency and exactly matches the first reference dimensions.
apimartStudio.svgHint: Required for standard SVG. Choose a text model supported by your APIMart account; its text usage is charged separately.
apimartStudio.svgExtHint: Optional for Ext 2.6 SVG. Leave blank to use the provider default.
apimartStudio.textOnlyHint: GIF and SVG support text-to-image only. GIF uses automatic frame size. Remove references and overlays before selecting these formats.
apimartStudio.billingHint: Quality auto may reserve funds at the maximum level for standard models. Higher quality and resolution may take longer. Check your provider account for pricing.
apimartStudio.asyncHint: Submitted once, then checked every 4 seconds for up to 5 minutes. Pausing stops checks, not the provider task.
apimartStudio.pollingHint: Checking the accepted task. No generation request is resubmitted.
apimartStudio.expiryHint: Result URLs are temporary. Download the files promptly; saving history stores links rather than permanent copies.
apimartStudio.unknownHint: Submission could not be confirmed. Check your provider account or enter its task ID above. A new submission may create a second paid task.
apimartStudio.acknowledgeUnknown: I have checked the provider task list and accept the risk of starting another task.
apimartStudio.receiptPending: The provider accepted this task, but its local receipt has not been saved. Recover the receipt to query it; this does not create a new task.
apimartStudio.receiptError: The receipt could not be recovered yet. Keep this page and try recovery again; do not resubmit generation.
apimartStudio.storageWarning: This browser could not preserve the task receipt. Copy the task ID before leaving this page.
apimartStudio.queryError: The task could not be checked. Its ID is preserved; resume checks instead of submitting again.
apimartStudio.pollTimeout: Automatic checks have paused after 5 minutes. The provider task may still be running; resume checks with the same ID.
apimartStudio.submitUnknown: The submission result is uncertain. No automatic generation retry was made.
apimartStudio.submitRejected: The request was rejected before task acceptance. Check your channel, account and settings.
apimartStudio.taskFailed: The provider reported task failure. Check your request and references before explicitly starting another task.
apimartStudio.taskCancelled: The provider reports that this task was cancelled.
apimartStudio.accountChanged: Return to the account that submitted this task to query or save it.
apimartStudio.signIn: Sign in before uploading or submitting an APIMart task.
apimartStudio.unavailable: This model or resolution is not available on your configured channel.
apimartStudio.uploadError: Upload failed. Successfully uploaded URLs remain in the reference list; retry only the missing files.
apimartStudio.fileError: Choose PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF files, no larger than 20 MB each.
apimartStudio.overlayFileError: Use a PNG. Masks must be under 4 MB; markup uploads must be no larger than 20 MB.
apimartStudio.confirmOverlay: Add an overlay and confirm its transparency and first-reference dimensions.
apimartStudio.invalidModel: Choose one of the supported GPT Image 2.5 or 2.6 models.
apimartStudio.invalidPrompt: Enter a prompt between 1 and 32,000 characters.
apimartStudio.invalidCount: Use an integer count of 1–4. Ext 2.6 and SVG require exactly one output.
apimartStudio.invalidOptions: Some options do not match this model. Check the resolution, format and advanced settings.
apimartStudio.invalidSize: Use an allowed aspect ratio or valid exact dimensions.
apimartStudio.invalidReferences: Use up to 16 valid public HTTP(S) image URLs. Ext models also accept image Base64 Data URLs.
apimartStudio.invalidOverlay: A mask or markup requires references and a matching transparent PNG URL. Check model support.
apimartStudio.overlayConflict: Use either a mask or markup, not both.
apimartStudio.textOnly: GIF and SVG cannot use references, masks or markup.
apimartStudio.svgRequired: Standard SVG output requires an SVG authoring text model.
apimartStudio.multipleIds: The provider returned multiple accepted tasks. Each ID is preserved. Pause checks to select another; save current results first.
